content: अवर्ण {%a.%} .²1 Colourless, having no marks. .²2 Bad, low, destitute of good qualities. .({@-र्णः@}) .²1 Scandal, illrepute, stigma, spot; सोढुं न तत्पूर्वमवर्णमीशे <ls>R. 14. 38</ls>. .²2 Blame, censure; न चावदद् भर्तुरवर्णमार्या <ls n="R. 14.">57</ls> spoke no ill words. .²3 Epithet of 18 letters according to ह्रस्व, दीर्घ, प्लुत, उदात्त, अनुदात्त <ab>&c.</ab>
